ceu: ✦ The square between the Moon and Jupiter at {H:1803656462000}

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and romance. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and family. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between money and friendships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and your career. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and relationships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.
